items.title: Design Harness: The Missing Layer Between “Looks Good” and “Actually Works”
items.content_text: Most product failures aren’t design failures in the traditional sense. The interface looked polished, the demo went well, stakeholders signed off, and it still broke the moment real users touched it. The gap isn’t taste. It’s that the design was never tested against reality before it shipped. That gap has a name: the design harness.
